title: The Unbroken Line: First Lesson

texts.details:
You can throw fire! Marvelous. So can a lit match. Sit, sit.

Two things today, and they're the same lesson, though you won't see it yet. First: conjure me water. Two flasks, made by you, out of nothing at all. Not from the inn. I'll know.

Second. Some weeks back an apprentice of mine made a familiar and forgot to unmake it. It's been drifting about in the snow outside the village ever since, getting bigger and upsetting the rams. We call it Flicker. Go and take it apart, $N.
texts.objectives: Conjure 2 Conjured Water for your teacher and unmake Flicker, which drifts in the snow near Kharanos. Then return.
texts.progress: Water first! Anyone can blow a thing up. I want to see you make one.
texts.completion:
Lovely water. Nice and cold. And Flicker's gone? Then you've done both halves of what a mage does. You've made a thing from nothing, and you've cleaned up after one.

Mind the second half. Every spell leaves something behind. Mine, yours, those of mages dead three thousand years. The world's full of what we forgot to unmake.

And here's a thing, $N. Someone taught me, and someone taught him, and back and back without a break, right to the very first. You're the newest link. I mean you to walk that line. Pick one of these. When you've twenty seasons, go to the human lands, to Elwynn Forest. There's a mage called Theocritus at the Tower of Azora, in the east of it.

idea: The Unbroken Line, level 10 (Alliance): conjure water and unmake a loose conjuration. Invented: Flicker.
